description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Orleans silos to use Event Hub streaming, specifically adding extension methods to ISiloBuilder for setting up Event Hub persistent streams with optional configuration.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to enable Event Hub streaming configuration.

methods.name: AddEventHubStreams
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Event Hub persistent streams with optional custom configuration.

methods.name: AddEventHubStreams
methods.description: Overload that configures Event Hub streams with default checkpointer and other settings through action delegates.
